acceptanceCriteria: A spec section in docs/specs/cem-stable-v1.md defines the verdict ledger record (mapSha256, target gitCommit and gitTree, verdictSha256, consumer, runtime.goVersion, recordedAt) as an append-only Git note under the existing cem anchor namespace, with a closed schema and refusal codes.

`corvint cem anchor` on a stable map with a verification result appends one record per (mapSha256, target) and refuses to overwrite a differing verdictSha256 for the same key with a named code; a read of the ledger is a read command that mutates nothing.
Native and portable consumers agree on verdictSha256 for every public stable case before any record is written (decision 0523 K6).
body: Deferred from V1-1265 lane split (wire owner, 2026-10-12). The V1-1265 ticket body says a later re-verification appends a record keyed by (mapSha256, target); the V1-1265 lanes land `verdictSha256` (CEM-V1-066) as a result member and route stable maps through `cem anchor` / `cem provenance` (ParseStable routing) but do not implement the append-only verdict ledger. Decision 0525 step 8 (V1-1283) consumes the sealed verdict from the sealed stable result packet, not from a ledger, so the ledger is not on the rc.3 critical path. Scope: an append-only per-(mapSha256, target) record of verdictSha256 in the anchor note namespace (internal/gitnotes), read-only listing, no authority or tier effect (product invariant 4: a read command never mutates; the append is an explicit write command).
title: cem/1.0: append-only verdict ledger keyed by (mapSha256, target) in the anchor note namespace (deferred from V1-1265)
